listening_note: No audio was played by this script and none was simulated. The refusal tests use a synthetic review_id in a sandbox copy of the queue; the real queue and the real decision log were opened read-only.

checks.check: every row is queued for audible review and none carries a verdict
checks.why_it_matters: 0 of 1,021 rows have been listened to, and the file must say so.

checks.check: every row names the source whose recording it is
checks.why_it_matters: 804 rows carried source_name null before Wave 4, because the builder read a payload field the staged rows do not have. A reviewer was given a URL and left to infer whose recording it is.

checks.check: every row has something to play
checks.why_it_matters: A row with no media cannot be reviewed and would sit forever.

checks.check: no row asserts a timestamp nobody measured
checks.why_it_matters: is_segmented must mean exactly 'a start offset is asserted'. The campaign's rule is that no boundary is invented, so the flag and the field must agree.

checks.check: no row awaiting its first hearing has promoted itself into the catalogue

strata_already_served_by_design.RV_1_65_TO_1_70_AFFECTED_SPAN: These 61 rows were shipped before this campaign and are queued for audible RE-review, not for promotion: the span is where an edition merges verse pairs, so the risk is a recording of the pair rather than of the verse. Their presence in the catalogue is the reason they are in the queue, not evidence that the queue leaked.

checks.why_it_matters: A staged mapping that reaches a reader without a listener is exactly what the queue exists to prevent, and the registry already described these rows as closed.

checks.server_said: verdict must be one of AUDIBLY_VERIFIED, AUDIBLY_REJECTED, AUDIBLE_REVIEW_UNCERTAIN
checks.why_it_matters: a fourth verdict would be a way to avoid deciding

checks.server_said: a verdict needs a named reviewer
checks.why_it_matters: a listening claim with no listener is what the queue exists to prevent

checks.check: AUDIBLY_VERIFIED is refused when nothing played
checks.server_said: AUDIBLY_VERIFIED requires the audio to have played. Nothing was heard for this row, so the only honest verdict available is AUDIBLE_REVIEW_UNCERTAIN.
checks.why_it_matters: this is the rule that makes 'do not simulate listening' mechanical

checks.server_said: REV-DOES-NOT-EXIST is not in the queue
checks.why_it_matters: a verdict on a row that is not in the queue would be unattributable

checks.check: UNCERTAIN is accepted with nothing played (the control)
checks.server_said: {'review_id': 'REV-WAVE4-QA-SYNTHETIC-NOT-A-REAL-ROW', 'verdict': 'AUDIBLE_REVIEW_UNCERTAIN', 'reviewer': 'wave4-qa', 'reviewed_at': '2026-09-16T10:10:14.269663+00:00', 'notes': 'synthetic QA row; nothing was heard and n
checks.why_it_matters: Uncertain must be as easy to record as the other two. A queue that makes uncertainty inconvenient collects false certainty -- and if every verdict were refused, the refusal tests above would be meaningless.

checks.check: the decision reached the append-only log on disk
checks.why_it_matters: The log is the record and the queue is a projection of it, so a decision has to survive the process dying immediately after the response.
